subsystems.note: stepped plate courses, gable triangles at x ends

content.text: Plan reviewed (the two overlaps are ring-vs-interior, intentional). Tan stylobate, two steps.
White colonnade: 16 round columns, 5 bricks tall.
Cella wall ring, 5 courses, doorway at the east end.
Terracotta roof: five stepped plate courses, low pitch, triangular gable ends.
